mapper.select:
select INDENTIFY_MARK as indentifyMark, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK as orgIndentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE as bankCode, IS_BELONG_BANK as isBelongBank, THE_BANK_NAME as theBankName, THE_BANK_CODE as theBankCode, HOLDER_MARK as holderMark, HOLDER_REGION as holderRegion, HOLDER_TYPE as holderType, PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE as personalIdentifyType, INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE as institutionIdentifyType, IDENTIFY_NUMBER as identifyNumber, SPV_CAP_ACC_BANK as spvCapAccBank, OTHER_CAP_ACC_BANK as otherCapAccBank, SPV_REGIST_CODE as spvRegistCode, HOLDER_DATE holderDate, HOLDER_NAME holderName, HOLDER_SEX holderSex, HOLDER_RISK_PREFER as holderRiskPrefer, HOLDER_CELLPHONE as holderCellphone, HOLDER_TELEPHONE as holderTelephone, HOLDER_EMAIL as holderEmail, TYPE as type, REMARK, SUBMIT_STATUS as submitStatus, SUBMIT_TIME as submitTime, CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE as chbSubmitDeadline, SUBMIT_DEADLINE as submitDeadline, STATUS as status, sub.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, status.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS as submitFeedbackStatus from chb_equ_sub sub left join CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS status on sub.sumit_seq = status.seqno

(sub.REGIST_BANK_CODE = #{item.REGIST_BANK_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and sub.INDENTIFY_MARK = #{item.INDENTIFY_MARK,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

update.foreach: update chb_equ_sub sub set sub.SUMIT_SEQ = #{item.sumitSeq} , sub.UPDATE_TIME = sysdate where sub.REGIST_BANK_CODE=#{item.bankCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and sub.INDENTIFY_MARK = #{item.indentifyMark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and sub.SUBMIT_STATUS = '02'

t2.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'
(#{item.REGIST_BANK_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.INDENTIFY_MARK,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
